title: Canvas materials sized in metres (brick, concrete, wood, leather, soil, rock)
summary: Procedural colour+bump canvas textures with a real tile size, tiled()/perMetre() materials and 20 critic-tuned presets: sooty brick, board-formed concrete, planks, leather, soils, rock, steel.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: import { tiled, perMetre, brick, boardConcrete, weatheredWood, fromRef } from '../library/module.recon.canvas-materials/index.js';
usage.example:
part(box(6, 2.95, .3), tiled(brick({ soot: .5, grime: .55, dark: .78, grey: .38 }), 6, 2.95, { rough: .9 }), at, null, G, 'wall');   // repeat = face m / 2x3 m tile
part(metricBox(.13, 3, .12), perMetre(weatheredWood(), { color: 0x9a8a7a, rot: Math.PI / 2 }), at, null, G, 'post');   // grain along the post
const orange = fromRef('#e65f14');   // sRGB sample -> linear

doc.when: Any recon surface that should read as a real material at a real scale: walls, slabs, floors, furniture, cut earth. Presets carry their canvas size in metres (set.tile).
doc.avoid: One texture tile stretched over a big face (plain BoxGeometry + repeat 1): it reads as planks or streaks. Strong horizontal strata on soil (reads as wood).
gotchas: tiled(set, w, h) is for 0..1 UV faces (repeat = w / tile); perMetre(set) is for metric-UV geometry (module.any.metric-box, module.any.relief).
Grain runs along u: pass rot: Math.PI / 2 on vertical members.
Textures are drawn once per parameter set and cached; materials clone them, so create materials after the engine is up (inside build or a lazy getter).
Colours given to materials are linear; convert reference samples with fromRef().
Procedural canvas textures plateau at 5-7/10 against photoreal AI references; 8+ needs scanned/PBR textures.

params.brick: seed, dark, grey, mortar, soot, grime, blots, streaks (canvas 2 x 3 m)
params.leather(channels): .6 m, use explicit repeat on cushions
params.tiled o: color rough metal bump unit repeat ox oy rot physical x
